turn.user_message: Walk me through the daily automation
turn.context: Automations place, turn 1 (one night on one ward, from the evening round to going home).

text: Here is one night on one ward, from the evening round to the patient going home.
Seven stations run by themselves. A person steps in at three of them, only to say yes.
chat.invite: Pick any station to go deeper. The summary is the best place to start.
chat.note: The machines work all night. People only say yes.

points.label: The summary on the evening round

prompts: How is the summary drafted all through the stay?
What does the doctor have to do?
chat.pointer: Play the night, or move the clock. Pick a station to open it.

sheets.title: Summary drafted
sheets.text: The doctor marks on the round that the patient can likely go. Tojo drafts the summary from notes already in your files.
sheets.entry: Who is on your evening round?

hand.does: Reads the early summary on the ward phone and signs it.

sheets.title: Bill and supplies brought up to date
sheets.text: Every charge is already on the bill. Tojo adds what the patient will use, and works out what goes back to the pharmacy.

hand.does: Confirms the discharge and signs in one tap.
